svg.title: Flowchart of one reply through the station: the tune when one is due, the checks before keying, each piece with its ID check, the IC-7300's metered watch or the keyer box's and handheld's unmetered watch until receive, and where each failure leads: inhibit, lockout until the next tune, or not keyed

Any error from transmit_inner forces receive: 17 FF, 1C 00 00, then
1C 00 must read receive twice in a row (at least 3 tries, up to 13 dots or
the rig's settle time). Not confirmed: inhibit. Faults and file writes
come only after that. Any error once a piece has gone to the keyer is a
fault; a second fault in a row, with no whole transmission between
a station step, or not keyed (no fault)
